name: Project enquiry
origin: Supported Default form from local-interactions/fixtures.json, with registered descriptive text and information card added deterministically.
program:
root = Col([Title("Contact details","lg"), Text("Tell the team about your next project.","sm","muted"), form, info], 5)
form = Form([Input("Maya","Name","text","Your name",{required:true}),Input("","Email","email","you@example.com",{required:true,email:true}),TextArea("","Message","Your message",3,{required:true}),Row([Button("Submit",null,"solid",null,null,null,false,false,"submit"),Button("Reset",null,"outline",null,null,null,false,false,"reset")],3,"center")])
info = Card([Title("What happens next","md"),Text("Our team will review your message within two working days.","sm")],"soft",5,3)

name: Image placeholders · Modern
origin: Local image-placeholder coverage; no model or external image request.
program:
root = Page([heading, cards, avatar])
heading = Heading("Image placeholders", "h1", "lg")
cards = Grid([hotel, product, portrait], 3, 180, 4)
hotel = Card([ImagePlaceholder("Hotel photograph", "landscape")], "Travel")
product = Card([ImagePlaceholder("Product image", "square")], "Products")
portrait = Card([ImagePlaceholder("Portrait photograph", "portrait")], "People")
avatar = ImagePlaceholder("Profile photo", "avatar")

name: Image placeholders · Default
origin: Local image-placeholder coverage; no model or external image request.
program:
root = Col([Title("Image placeholders", "lg"), cards, ImagePlaceholder("Profile photo", "avatar")], 4)
cards = Grid([hotel, product, portrait], 3, 180, 4)
hotel = Card([Title("Travel", "md"), ImagePlaceholder("Hotel photograph", "landscape")])
product = Card([Title("Products", "md"), ImagePlaceholder("Product image", "square")])
portrait = Card([Title("People", "md"), ImagePlaceholder("Portrait photograph", "portrait")])
